warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLE63 AMG Valve Seal & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: GLE63 AMG engines — both the M157 (W166 generation) and the M177 (V167 generation), across every GLE63 AMG generation — commonly show valve seal and coolant system wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern among AMG specialists, cross-referenced across Mercedes models including the S-Class, CLS, E-Class and G-Class.
We replace valve seals and inspect and replace coolant system components as standard on every GLE63 AMG rebuild, along with the timing chain where worn.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, cross-referenced across the Mercedes G-BRF (S-Class, CLS, E-Class, G-Class), per VRF-mercedes-gle-class.md
